test: Find erp_sales_order_lines with qty_shipped>0 and no finance_invoice_lines row on line_id. Break down by ship year, age vs last day, fulfilment, branch, customer, SKU. Check (a) another invoice line on the same order+SKU (rebill), (b) WMS sale movement for order+SKU (real shipment; special lines never hit WMS), (c) unit_price=0, (d) whether the order has other invoices. Size per year at order price over 2016-2024.
support: Steady ~430-630 lines/yr across 2016-2024, months past ship_day, WMS sale movements present for non-special lines, no other invoice line for same order+SKU, positive prices, spread across branches/customers.
weaken: Lines re-billed on a different line of the same order/SKU, no WMS sale movement, $0 prices, or concentration in 2025 end effects or one system artefact (e.g. special-only, one branch).
expect: Moderately strong support: I expect the steady leakage to hold (~0.25-0.35M/yr) since invoice lines map 1:1 and the map says qty and price always match. Possible weakening: a large share may be special-order lines that never touch WMS, so WMS confirmation would be limited to non-special lines.
